cleanup: Probe closes both HTTP clients and drains every owned offer task. Mayor owns native/gateway process groups and must stop/join the disposable stack even on refusal; do not restore by an unplanned command.
credential_policy: Never capture environment/config/auth header values. Known private auth value is removed from unexpected echoed bodies/errors before any evidence write.
executor: Mayor only, on the existing isolated Source13 research stack

observability.actual_applied_at: No exact post-write timestamp. Preserve the raw applied_at claim but report an interval ending at the next actual state snapshot, never acknowledgement as a point application time.
observability.effect_scope: Gateway public admission budget, not native scheduler token/batch capacity or throughput improvement.
observability.native_context: Legacy before/after state retained; final full scheduler/issued-queue observations in the same3s window. Exact scope and fixed refusal procedure are preregistered in AMENDMENT02.json.
observability.negative_evidence: Version-monotone, same-domain, same-run public snapshots plus a bounded post-rejection watch; not proof against arbitrary effects after the watch.
observability.server_checked_at: Successful CAS response applied_at is the source-proven pre-write expiry-check sample; rejection responses expose no check time.
observability.server_received_at: Not exposed by the immutable endpoint.

on_failure: Stop issuing new commands/offers; retain unsent planned rows, all attempted outcomes and raw redacted receipts. Perform read-only bounded final observations. No retry or fallback command.
prompt: Answer only with the word ready.
question: Do fixed public admission-budget commands apply before their guard deadline, and do expired/stale-version commands leave budget and version unchanged throughout a bounded watch?
